notes.text: Maximum occupancy for Mixing Shed R-101 is 5 workers strictly enforced.
Potassium Chlorate and Sulphur must be stored in separate ventilated rooms.
Emergency SOS siren triggers auto-notification and 15-second high-priority alarm.
Worker shift clock-in requires biometric verification and Tamil wage passbook signing.

precautions: Ensure anti-static grounding mats are active.
Mandatory PPE: Nitrile gloves, safety goggles, cotton apron.
Fire extinguisher Type ABC must be within 3 meters.
